title: LAN & Route Snapshot
description: Collects active IPv4 routes and ARP/NDP neighbors on Kali and saves /ext/apps_data/zero2zero/lan_neighbors.txt.
command:
import pathlib, subprocess; r = subprocess.run(['ip', '-4', 'route'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(); n = subprocess.run(['ip', '-4', 'neigh'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(); out = '=== Routes ===
' + (r or '(none)') + '

=== Neighbors ===
' + (n or '(none)'); pathlib.Path('lan_neighbors.txt').write_text(out + '
'); print(out[:600])
